title: action-body compile check: a regular-expression pattern error QuickJS also refuses (unterminated group, nothing to repeat, …) still takes the warning arm, so the body is accepted at write and every run fails (after #35672)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTggz8AL2bCABoDGis

Filed by the #35040 card thread, at the seat's direction (L2 adoption 7025094291 on PR #35672). Source: the contract review of PR #35672, record 7025076166, item ③ (escalated "not filed, carrier: none"), plus its nits N1, N2 and N4, which ride this card.

## What happens
After PR #35672, `action-body-does-not-compile` (`packages/lint/src/validate-action-body-compiles.ts`) refuses the two regex **token** classes (unterminated literal, invalid flags) and keeps every regex **pattern** failure V8 reports (`Invalid regular expression: /PATTERN/FLAGS: REASON`) at `warning`. That carve-out exists for the two measured dialect gaps, where V8 (Node 22) refuses and QuickJS runs: duplicate named capture groups and modifier groups `(?i:a)`.

But the PR's own probe table (V8 12.4 vs quickjs-emscripten 0.32.0, same wrapper) shows six pattern classes that **QuickJS refuses too**: unterminated group `/(/`, nothing to repeat `/a**/`, class range out of order `/[b-a]/`, and under `u` a dangling named back-reference, an unknown unicode property `/\p{Nope}/u` and an incomplete quantifier `/a{/u`. A body carrying one is accepted at write (`warning`), deploys, and every run of the action answers the coded 500 — the failure #34884 was fixed for. Test line 87 of `validate-action-body-compiles.test.ts` currently pins one of the six (unterminated group) at `warning`.

## Reproduce (on `main` once PR #35672 has landed)
1. Probe the host side: `node -e 'const vm=require("node:vm"); try { new vm.Script("(async (input, ctx) => { return /(/;\n})") } catch (e) { console.log(e.message) }'` prints `Invalid regular expression: /(/: Unterminated group`, the pattern shape the rule sends to `warning`.
2. Run the rule: `validateActionBodyCompiles` over a stack with one action `{ name: 'a', type: 'script', body: { language: 'js', source: 'return /(/;' } }` answers one finding, `severity: 'warning'` (test line 87 pins exactly this).
3. Probe the runtime side: `quickjs-emscripten` 0.32.0 release-sync `evalCode` of the same wrapper text refuses it (`expecting ')'`), so the deployed action answers the coded 500 on every run.
Repeat 1 to 3 with `/a**/`, `/[b-a]/`, `/\k<x>/u`, `/\p{Nope}/u` and `/a{/u`: V8 pattern sentence, rule `warning`, QuickJS refuses. Controls that must stay `warning`: `/(?<a>x)|(?<a>y)/` and `/(?i:a)/` (V8 refuses, QuickJS compiles).

## Done when
A pattern failure that the runtime's QuickJS also refuses is refused at `error`, while the measured dialect gaps (duplicate named group, modifier group) stay `warning`. The choice of mechanism is this card's (an allow-list of V8 pattern reasons, which a later V8 can widen, or a different judge); the PR records the measurement it rests on. Pins cover each of the six classes and both preserved gaps.

## Riding nits from record 7025076166
- N1: the two "still only warns" pins (duplicate named group, modifier group) hold only on Node 22's V8; on a later Node the rule returns no finding and they go red. CI is pinned to Node 22 by `.nvmrc`.
- N2: the `os explain` paragraph in `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` names those two pattern differences as a fact about "this host's engine" with no Node 22 qualifier.
- N4: the unterminated-literal hint and the `replacement` of semantic entry `action-body-regexp-literal-token-refused` omit one cause: a line terminator inside the literal (what a single-backslash `\n` in a quoted or JSON-carried `body.source` becomes).

Grade: left to triage.
Not in scope: hook and job bodies (#34987).
